standards.title: Multi Token Standard
standards.role: Candidate multi-token interface, not a carbon registry entitlement mechanism.

standards.title: Non-Fungible Token Standard
standards.role: Alternative for unique serial-specific assets; no legal rights arise merely by minting.

standards.title: Typed structured data hashing and signing
standards.role: Future human-approved attestation signing; signature standard alone is not replay protection or registry authorization.

standards.title: Core Carbon Principles
standards.role: Program registry tracking, robust quantification, independent verification, avoidance of double counting.

institutional_policies.title: Verra Addresses Crypto Instruments and Tokens
institutional_policies.scope: Retired credits cannot be tokenized as environmental credits under announced policy; current contract-specific requirements require separate written registry review.

institutional_policies.title: Conditions for consenting to tokenisation of Gold Standard-issued credits
institutional_policies.scope: Registry terms require express written consent for issuing carbon-credit-related tokens; verify current operative version before implementation.

institutional_policies.title: ICVCM Assessment Framework
institutional_policies.scope: No double issuance, double claiming or double use.

institutional_policies.title: J-クレジットのトークン化に関する分析：公表案内
institutional_policies.scope: Rights representation, registry legal control, fractional units and potential pre-certification designs must be analysed separately; not a blanket ban.

institutional_policies.title: 金融庁 カーボン・クレジット取引に関する金融インフラのあり方等に係る検討会
institutional_policies.scope: Transparency, market integrity, fair access and legal characterisation; no conclusion that all carbon tokens belong to a single financial instrument category.

institutional_policies.title: 環境省 J-クレジット制度MRV支援システム運営者の採択
institutional_policies.scope: Official digital MRV exists; no claim that NaFT is an approved operator.
